2609.35745.title: Copy the Same, Distill the Difference: Initializing Linear Vision Transformers
2609.35745.paper_summary: Linear Vision Transformers (ViTs) are designed to replace the attention in Softmax ViTs with the linear-complexity attention operator for more efficient token routing, but they require from-scratch pre-training and typically underperform the original Softmax version. How to initialize linear ViTs both efficiently and effectively still remains unclear. In this work, we explicitly ask: given that most foundation ViTs are built on the mainstream Softmax attention, can linear ViTs benefit from their pre-trained weights? Recent works on Attention Transfer show that attention is the effective transferable component between Softmax ViTs, suggesting attention alone suffices for such reuse. However, we find the opposite for Softmax-to-linear transfer. The attention weights are operator-specific: copying them barely helps, and is sometimes even worse than random initialization. Instead, the attention's token routing behavior can be recovered through distillation with a proper loss design, letting linear ViTs reduce the gap and even match Softmax ones. In contrast, the MLP weights, which carry the learned representation, are operator-agnostic: they can be transferred by simple direct copying, which already carries most of the benefit of the pre-trained weights. Thus, copying MLPs can serve as an effective foundation for Softmax-to-linear transfer: paired with the distilled attention, linear ViTs eventually close the remaining gap and even surpass Softmax ones. These findings hold consistently across various linear ViT variants, different model sizes, and diverse datasets. We hope this study deepens the understanding of reusing pre-trained weights across attention operators: copy what stays the same and distill what differs, to recover the benefit across the Softmax-to-linear boundary.
2609.35745.paper_summary_zh: 線性視覺Transformer（ViTs）旨在用線性複雜度的注意力運算子取代Softmax ViTs中的注意力，以實現更高效的標記路由，但它們需要從頭開始進行預訓練，並且通常表現不如原始的Softmax版本。如何有效且高效地初始化線性ViTs仍然不清楚。在這項工作中，我們明確提出：考慮到大多數基礎ViTs是基於主流的Softmax注意力構建的，線性ViTs能否從其預訓練權重中受益？最近關於注意力轉移的研究顯示，注意力是Softmax ViTs之間有效的可轉移組件，這表明僅僅注意力就足以進行這樣的重用。然而，我們發現Softmax到線性轉移的情況正好相反。注意力權重是運算子特定的：複製它們幾乎沒有幫助，有時甚至比隨機初始化更糟。相反，通過適當的損失設計進行蒸餾可以恢復注意力的標記路由行為，使線性ViTs縮小差距，甚至達到Softmax的水平。相比之下，攜帶學習表示的MLP權重是運算子無關的：它們可以通過簡單的直接複製進行轉移，這已經帶來了預訓練權重的大部分好處。因此，複製MLP可以作為Softmax到線性轉移的有效基礎：配合蒸餾的注意力，線性ViTs最終縮小了剩餘的差距，甚至超越了Softmax的表現。這些發現在線性ViT的各種變體、不同的模型大小和多樣的數據集上都一致成立。我們希望這項研究能加深對於跨注意力運算子重用預訓練權重的理解：複製保持不變的部分，蒸餾不同的部分，以恢復在Softmax到線性邊界上的好處。
